name: mia-rosie-midnight-mysteries
description: Mia & Rosie: Midnight Mysteries — Google Flow, 9:16, off-screen warm narrator, expressive 3D animated characters whose mouths never move, gentle moonlit mystery look.
base_look: Expressive Pixar-like 3D animation, cinematic lighting, midnight-blue and lavender palette with crimson accents, gentle child-friendly mystery mood, vertical 9:16.
closing: Clean frame, free of subtitles, captions, watermarks and logos, with every mouth closed.
visual_rules: Characters are animated, never photoreal. The narrator is off-screen: Mia's lips stay pressed together and Rosie's stitched mouth never moves in any clip.
Mia and Rosie are generated from the character reference images (ingredients) and the locked Look anchors, pasted verbatim, so faces, outfits and the bedroom never drift.
Moonlit midnight-blue and lavender light with crimson accents; gentle mystery, never gore or realistic horror.
Avoid readable text, many hands and crowds; one slow, simple action per clip.
